notes.title: Danger Gazers Has Launched!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34640232/a4c3228eed877cb00e3b02ababc086a46674f029.png
Danger Gazers Has Launched!

Happy New Year! And the day has finally come.

Danger Gazers has officially left Early Access, and is ready for the new players who were patiently waiting for the full release! 😉

https://i.imgur.com/teToRWr.gif

The game has come a long way since it went into Early Access in May 2019. All thanks to your amazing support and feedback! Major changes and even all the minor tweaks have contributed towards the unique experience that the full release has to offer now.

Once again I'd like to thank you for your comments and support, all the bug reports and your patience.

Have fun!

v1.0 Changes
 Increased bullet speed for the weaker guns.
 Increased hero walk speed.
 Rebalanced items and guns.
 UI improvements.
 Added localization.
 Added new achievements.
 Added the final boss.
 Added help book.
 Performance optimizations.
 Minor tweaks and fixes.

notes.content:

notes.title: Dead Ground Coming February 1st!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31653427/cbbd723472b4dbd696afaeb014c1281180049560.gif

So you think you are ready for the most challenging Tower Defense game?

Well, I've got some good news for you then! Dead Ground will be available on February 1st for Windows and Linux!

If you are a tower defense fan who is looking for something new, be sure to add the game to your wishlist, so that you won't miss the release date.
